source.quote: Cyrus Audio's own page for the 80 PRE preamplifier, read 2026-11-25. « ESS Sabre ES9039Q2M 32 bit DAC »; « Up to 32bit/384kHz PCM »; « DSD256 »; « Digital inputs: 2x optical, 1x coaxial, 1x USB-B »; « Streaming: UPnP, Roon Ready, AirPlay 2, Spotify Connect, TIDAL Connect, Qobuz ».

_les_conditions_de_Cyrus_ont_ete_lues: cyrusaudio.com's terms page and its separate copyright page were both READ. Neither forbids quoting or reusing specification text: the copyright page asserts ordinary copyright in the site's content and names no permitted or forbidden reuse. That is the fourteenth brand of this shape - plain copyright with no reuse clause - and it is recorded as read rather than as absent.
_une_entree_USB_B_que_le_streamer_na_pas: « 1x USB-B » here, against the 40 ST's « USB-A for local storage » alone. So the preamplifier takes a computer's audio stream and the streamer does not, on an otherwise identical digital board. The device ceilings are given once for the whole device with no per-socket figure, so `inputs` is absent as on the 40 ST - the USB-B is known to exist and its ceiling is not published.
